Name: Splatoon Weapon
Author: Syuchinikurin
Description:
添加了一些来自斯普拉顿的刷子和滚筒，滚筒用的是锤子的模型右键横排效果特别好。暂时只能矿井随机掉落，下次更新会加到冒险者工会。正在做Hime的无人机，会放在这个mod里下次更新。

This mod adds several brushes and rollers inspired by [i]Splatoon[/i]. Currently, they can only be found as random drops in the mines, but they will be added to the Adventurer's Guild in the next update. Pearl Drone is in development and will be included in the next version.
